### Bugfixes

#### stdlib

- _(collection)_ **[regression]** Fix `Enum.parse?` max bytesize buffer limit ([#17836], thanks @straight-shoota)
- _(crypto)_ Reject malformed Bcrypt hashes ([#17677], thanks @Blacksmoke16)
- _(networking)_ **[security]** Fix validate service for `getaddrinfo` is in range ([#17848], thanks @straight-shoota)
- _(networking)_ **[security]** Fix reject control whitespace before field value in HTTP headers ([#17903], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(networking)_ **[security]** Fix `close` token in `Connection` header must close connection ([#17904], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(networking)_ **[security]** Fix `HTTP::ChunkedContent` must validate the chunk-line ([#17898], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(networking)_ **[security]** Fix HTTP must validate content-length header ([#17902], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(runtime)_ **[security]** Fix `IO::Delimited` matching after a fragmented delimiter mismatch ([#17916], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(serialization)_ Fix reject NUL byte in IO-based JSON lexer ([#17897], thanks @straight-shoota)
- _(system)_ Fix `Process::INITIAL_PWD` to ignore access denied error ([#17748], thanks @straight-shoota)
- _(system)_ Fix `File.symlink` discover target file type on Windows ([#17742], thanks @straight-shoota)

### Bugfixes

#### stdlib

- _(crypto)_ **[security]** Fix invalid `OpenSSL::SSL::Options::ALL` option ([#17657], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(crypto)_ Allow exactly 72 byte bcrypt passwords ([#17676], thanks @Blacksmoke16)
- _(networking)_ **[regression]** Send `Content-Length: 0` for `POST` and `PUT` without body ([#17631], thanks @dentarg)
- _(networking)_ **[regression]** Send `Content-Length: 0` for `PATCH` without body ([#17632], thanks @dentarg)
- _(runtime)_ **[regression]** Fix `Fiber::ExecutionContext::Isolated` resuming its fiber without an event ([#17630], thanks @dentarg)
- _(runtime)_ Refactor io_uring event loop's sleep to use timers ([#17655], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(runtime)_ Fix adjust IP before resolving backtraces ([#17622], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(runtime)_ Fix race condition in select timeout action ([#17640], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(runtime)_ `Crystal.init_runtime` must create main Thread and Fiber ([#17688], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(serialization)_ Fix out-of-bounds reads in `XML::Node#name` ([#17648], thanks @zw963)
- _(system)_ Fix `FileUtils.rm_r` failing on a symlink loop ([#17613], thanks @jochenseeber)
- _(text)_ **[regression]** Fix out-of-bound access in `String#scan_byte_index` ([#17625], thanks @HertzDevil)
- _(text)_ Fix `String::Builder` buffer grows capacity for trailing zero ([#17650], thanks @straight-shoota)

- _(codegen)_ Do not redeclare lib funs or LLVM intrinsics in the main LLVM module ([#17637], [#17672], thanks @HertzDevil)
- _(debugger)_ Set debug location before inlining a call ([#17602], thanks @Blacksmoke16)
- _(semantic)_ Fix propagate raises state to target defs in call cycles ([#17656], thanks @ysbaddaden)
- _(semantic)_ Fix `IndexError` condition in strict 1-to-n assignment with splats ([#17675], thanks @HertzDevil)
